description: List / search restaurants in a Tock metro. Pass a metro slug (from tock_list_metros, e.g. "chicago") and an optional text query. Returns venues with cuisine, price band, neighborhood, and their Tock slug (use it with tock_get_restaurant / tock_get_availability). Does NOT include bookable slots.

query.description: Free-text filter (cuisine or venue name) applied server-side.

name: tock_search_restaurants
